_comment: Per-file LOC ceilings for files currently exceeding the global budgets in lint-locs.mjs. Each entry is a documented exception with a target for future decomposition. CI fails if a file in this list grows BEYOND its ceiling. New files must stay under the global budget (1500 LOC for src/pages, 500 LOC for top-level api/*.js).

exceptions.reason: buildContext now injects policy_impact_events with methodology/analyst_note/raw_provisions sections. Decomposition target: extract buildContext to api/lib/_lensContext.js — would drop main orchestrator back under 350 LOC. Tracked for next refactor sprint.

Library cockpit went 1500 → 1508 after Phase 2C added the Comparisons tab + saved-count fetcher + onConvertOrphan handler. The orphan Supabase work already extracted to lib/orphanConversion.js. Decomposition target for Phase 6: lift the bulk-ops handlers (selectedIds + toggleSelect + handleBulk*) into a useBulkSelection hook, and pull the layout-toggle + pagination wiring into a useLibraryLayout hook — would drop main page back under 1300 LOC.

Crossed 1500 → 1515 when the Structure Comparison section (§4 'which structure pays best here') was wired into the Lens results. The comparison UI itself is already extracted to components/lens/StructureComparison.jsx + lib/structureCompare.js; only the ~18-line section wiring lives here. Decomposition target: extract the entire `{results && (...)}` results panel into a <LensResults> component (passing form/stateProgram/scores/handlers as props) — the form + state + handlers stay in Search.jsx and the page drops well under 1000 LOC. Tracked for the next refactor sprint.
